citation: Lucius B. Marsh, The Genealogy of John Marsh of Salem and His Descendants, 1633–1886, Martin Cleland family entry.
locator: entry stating Martin Cleland went from Chautauqua, New York, to Chicago on a prospecting tour in 1834 and moved the family to Niles, Michigan in 1835
note: Later family genealogy, used conservatively because it gives an unusually specific dated migration route matching the uncommon exact name. It corroborates a Chicago trip in 1834 but also places the family's 1835 destination at Niles, Michigan; it is not evidence of July 1835 Chicago residence.
